name.zh: 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第六门 艾尔伊洛

location.zh: 精灵太空站 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第六门

reward_note: Each door boss, when beaten, gave its 暗黑精灵's 精元 (4399 2010-06-04: 通关后获得精元), hatching the line's first stage.

capture.zh: 暗黑武斗场暗黑第六门：100级艾尔伊洛，约1500血。打败获得艾尔伊洛精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 先用盖亚或丽莎布布消除它的天生强化，再用光系/暗系强攻；或雷伊麻痹后尤纳斯黑暗之门。

engine_notes: Entry (original): 超能NoNo owners loaded the 反物质芯片 directly; others needed NoNo AI level 10 and a crafted 反物质芯片 (VIP-gated). Doors open in order: 试炼之门, then 暗黑第一门 … 第九门 (pre-2013). The remake drops the VIP gate.
Innate boost (天生带强化效果, 本来就强化过) — stat and size not stated; atk+2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19); clearable.
Stage-downs have no effect (减攻击、减防御无效; user decision 2026-10-19); its innate boost can still be cleared.
source_note: 4399 第六门攻略: No.297 超能系 Lv100 HP1500, 天生强化.
